versions.changelog:
No file changes detected since the previous release.

- Version bumped to 0.0.2 with no functional or documentation updates.
- No user-facing or internal changes; behavior is identical to v0.0.1.

Initial public release — register and authenticate AI agents onchain with ERC-8004 and SIWA:

- Enables agent Ethereum wallet creation and secure management via a keyring proxy (private keys never accessible to the agent process).
- Supports agent registration on ERC-8004 Identity Registry as NFT-based autonomous agents.
- Implements SIWA (Sign In With Agent): authenticate using challenge-response signatures proving control of an onchain agent identity.
- Allows creation and update of agent metadata (with endpoints, trust models, services) and storage on IPFS or as data URIs.
- Provides API for onchain identity lookup and verification.
- Adopts MEMORY.md for storing only public identity state—never private keys.
